headline: Premier League clubs are overspending on wingers who can't score goals
description: After Messi and Ronaldo proved wingers can do more than cross the ball, why are Premier League clubs paying so much for so little production?

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal set for Rice talks to ward off Real Madrid interest
description: Real Madrid are eyeing up Declan Rice, but Arsenal are making moves to keep him. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Can versatile Iliman Ndiaye avoid Manchester City's expensive talent graveyard?
description: "When Manchester City comes though, you don't say no," Iliman Ndiaye said after making his debut for his new club against Coventry City this weekend.

headline: 'Centre-half' Declan Rice wouldn't start for Man City, Real Madrid - Graeme Souness
description: Graeme Souness has doubled down on his criticism of Declan Rice, reiterating the Arsenal midfielder is more of a defender and claiming he wouldn't start for any of his club's top European rivals.

headline: Newcastle sporting director Ross Wilson: Need to trade players to be successful in Premier League
description: Sporting director Ross Wilson believes success for Newcastle rests on them being a trading club going forwards after a summer of fluctuating fortunes in the transfer window.

headline: Erling Haaland fears lack of break could take toll as Man City star reveals unusual escape
description: Erling Haaland has revealed chopping wood and sitting by the fire has become his favourite way to switch off from football as the Manchester City striker admitted his fears over a lack of a summer break.
